jyutping: hoeng3 sai1 bak1 min6 heoi3 ge3

english.note: Use this when the thing or route is going toward the northwest rather than merely being located there.

examples.english: This route goes in a northwestern direction.
examples.traditional: 呢條路係向西北面去嘅。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hai6 hoeng3 sai1 bak1 min6 heoi3 ge3
